task.title: To insert fields in a template as a section

step.cmd: Open a template in X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
In the Work tab, click Fields.
Place the cursor in the section of the template text, where you want to insert a field and click Insert Field. This open the Insert Fields dialog box.
On theInsert Field popup, select an object (For example, "Agreement") from the left column.
To search a field related to the selected object in the right column, enter a keyword and click the Search icon () or press enter.
On Mac: in the window to the right, hold command and select one or more fields from the list. On Windows: hold Ctrl (keyboard key) and select the fields.

note.p: Fields are inserted one below the other based on the order you select. Do not move your cursor when the fields are being inserted.

step.cmd: Click the Insert as a Section radio button.
Click Insert. A repeat section is inserted into your template with each field displayed one below the other.

ol.li: Navigate to the Fields tab. This displays the Repeat Section (object name) and the fields in the repeat section.
Enter the field name in the search field and click the Search icon ().

step.cmd: To make an inserted field smart field or read-only:

ol.li: Click theSettings icon () adjacent to the selected field name to open the Settings page.
Toggle theSmart Field or Read-Only Fieldswitch based on your requirement and click Save.
